title: 第1099章 战后乱局第1098章 被迫停战
lines: 此刻的杜家内部已经大乱，他们的天境强者全部战死了。可是令人悲哀的是他们竟然没有人为了他们的族内强者伤心，而是在争抢族内宝库中的宝物。
“萧族长，破开这里，杜家的须弥界就会显现！”石破天轻声道。
萧羽点点头，手中的戮神一刀便是斩了下去，轰隆隆的声音响起。一座巨大的漂浮的大陆出现。
“杜家，我来了！”
萧羽一步便是跨了进去，石破天紧随其后。
当萧羽出现的那一刻，下方还在战斗的武者均是停下了手，随即他们便是惊骇的看着萧羽。
只是他们的话还没有说完，萧羽的刀便是斩了下去。石破天动了动嘴，最终什么也没有说，只是摇头叹息了一声。
浓烈的黒焰向着整个须弥姐蔓延开来，浓雾当中有男子咒骂，有妇人的惨叫，也有孩童的撕心裂肺的哭叫，萧羽却是不为所动。
直到整个大陆都没有任何生机存在的时候，萧羽才收回了黑焰，识海世界打开，一队妖族战士落地。
“收集这里所有资源后返回天武大陆。”
萧羽下达这样一个命令之后，便是带着石破天离开。
“下一处，谢家！”萧羽的声音冰冷。
“萧族长，其实现在的九大世家已经没有什么威胁了，不如将其祖境之上的强者斩杀，留他们一丝血脉？”石破天知道在天元城的时候，杜君剑曾经出手偷袭过萧羽，所以他不敢求情，但是其它几家他认为罪不及全族。
萧羽看了一眼石破天，“里通外敌，背叛天元！此罪不可恕，九族当灭！”
“不如此，我天元死去的子民何以瞑目？！”
只是一眼，石破天便是一抖，不敢再出言，低头带着萧羽前往谢家。谢家的情况和杜家大差不差，萧羽同样一刀斩之！
空荡的大殿之内，跪在地上的身影一个接一个的苏醒，他们身上散发出来的气息，让空间都是出现了扭曲。
一道身穿金色法袍的身影骤然出现，“都继续跪着！”
“何人断吾等族人血脉？！”空洞的声音在大殿之内回荡着。
“区区一些没有用的废物罢了，只要你们还活着，再生一批就是了，血脉之力会比现在的更好！”
金袍人丝毫不在意的道。
“你竟然敢如此羞辱我等？！”另外的一道声音响起。
“你们若是敢擅自离开这里，当知道主上的手段！”金袍人严厉警告。
此话一出，大殿渐渐的重新归于沉寂。
金袍人转过身看向上方悬浮的巨棺，微微思索了一下，身影便是消失。
石破天站在萧羽的身边，他的心情十分的复杂，谁能想到曾经和他石家平起平坐的九大世家竟然在不到三日之内血脉断绝。
“萧族长，石枯木那里传来消息，那些异族已经有强者试图强闯天元城，已经被他斩杀，虽然只是为数不多的一部分，但是他们的基数实在太大了，而且他们都是祖境以上的强者，虽然没有天境，但是这股力量若是在我们天元之内扎根的话，未来必是大患。”
“放心吧，我不会给他们成长时间的。”萧羽轻声道。
“那你打算怎么做？”
content_en:
At this moment, the Du family was in chaos, and all their Heaven Realm experts were killed in the battle. But the sad thing is that no one of them is sad for the strong man in their clan, but they are fighting for the treasures in the clan's treasure house.
"Chief Xiao, if you break this place, the Sumeru Realm of the Du family will appear!" Shi Potian said softly.
Xiao Yu nodded, and slashed down with the god-killing sword in his hand, and a rumbling sound was heard. A huge floating continent appeared.
"Du family, I'm here!"
Xiao Yu stepped in with one step, followed closely by Shi Potian.
The moment Xiao Yu appeared, the warriors who were still fighting below stopped, and then they looked at Xiao Yu in horror.
"Sir, we..."
But before they finished speaking, Xiao Yu's knife slashed down. Shi Potian moved his mouth, but finally said nothing, just shook his head and sighed.
Thick black flames spread towards the entire Sister Xumi. In the thick fog, there were men cursing, women screaming, and children crying heartbreakingly, but Xiao Yu remained unmoved.
It was only when there was no life left in the entire continent that Xiao Yu withdrew the black flames, the world of Consciousness Sea opened, and a group of monster warriors landed.
"Collect all the resources here and return to Tianwu Continent."
After Xiao Yu gave such an order, he took Shi Potian away.
"Next place, the Xie family!" Xiao Yu's voice was cold.
"Chief Xiao, in fact, there is no threat to the nine great families now. Why don't we kill the strong men above the ancestral realm and leave a trace of their blood?" Shi Potian knew that Du Junjian had sneak attacked Xiao Yu when he was in Tianyuan City, so he did not dare to plead for mercy, but he believed that the other families were not as guilty as the whole clan.
Xiao Yu glanced at Shi Potian, "Talking inside and outside the enemy, betraying Tianyuan! This crime is unforgivable, and the nine tribes must be destroyed!"
"Otherwise, how can my dead people of Tianyuan rest in peace?!"
With just one glance, Shi Potian shuddered, not daring to say anything anymore, lowering his head and taking Xiao Yu to Xie's house. The situation of the Xie family is very different from that of the Du family, Xiao Yu also killed them with one sword!
...
In the empty hall, the figures kneeling on the ground woke up one after another, and the auras emanating from their bodies caused the space to become distorted.
A figure wearing a golden robe suddenly appeared, "Everyone continues to kneel!"
"Who will cut off the bloodline of our people?!" A hollow voice echoed in the hall.
"It's just some useless trash. As long as you are still alive, just make another batch. The power of blood will be better than what you have now!"
The man in golden robe said without caring at all.
"How dare you humiliate us like this?!" Another voice sounded.
"If you dare to leave here without permission, you should know the Lord's methods!" The man in golden robe warned sternly.
As soon as these words came out, the hall gradually fell silent again.
The man in golden robe turned around and looked at the giant coffin suspended above, thought for a moment, and then disappeared.
Shi Potian stood next to Xiao Yu. His mood was very complicated. Who would have thought that the nine aristocratic families who were once equal to his Shi family would have their bloodlines cut off in less than three days.
"Clan Chief Xiao, there is news from Shi Kumu that some strong men from the alien race have tried to break into Tianyuan City and have been killed by him. Although they are only a small number, their base is too large, and they are all strong men above the ancestral realm. Although they do not have the heaven realm, if this power takes root in our Tianyuan City, it will be a big trouble in the future."
"Don't worry, I won't give them time to grow up." Xiao Yu said softly.
"Then what are you going to do?"
